us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Homeland Security secretary faces Congress after flight disruptions
bullets: Markwayne Mullin is appearing before Congress on homeland-security threats.
Lawmakers are questioning nationwide flight disruptions and immigration enforcement issues.
His football-trip travel during airport chaos is also under scrutiny.

articles.title: White House withdraws FDA nominee Heidi Overton
bullets: The White House pulled Dr. Heidi Overton’s FDA nomination Tuesday.
Senate Republican support had wavered before the withdrawal.
Public-health activists also opposed parts of her nomination.

articles.title: Congress skeptical of $50 billion air-traffic-system request
bullets: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy urged major air-transportation-system funding.
The request follows last week’s nationwide aviation ground stop.
FAA changes aim to prevent another similar travel disruption.

articles.title: Trump lands in China amid US technology-outage concerns
bullets: Trump arrived in Shenzhen for meetings centered on technology and trade.
Recent US technical outages have complicated the administration’s messaging.
Officials said no deliberate cyberattack evidence had emerged.

articles.title: US-China competition in focus as Trump and Xi meet
bullets: Trump and Xi are meeting again during a high-stakes Asia trip.
Manufacturing, trade, technology and minerals are central issues.
China’s export dominance remains a major US concern.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Iran widens Gulf attacks to Kuwait and Bahrain sites
bullets: Iran targeted a US air base in Kuwait, AP reported.
Several Bahrain sites were also attacked Wednesday.
The strikes followed earlier American attacks in the region.

articles.title: Xi urges open Asia-Pacific trade as APEC leaders gather
bullets: Xi Jinping addressed executives on APEC’s sidelines in Shenzhen.
He called for open trade and equitable regional growth.
Vladimir Putin also criticized sanctions during the gathering.

articles.title: Trump’s Asia trip includes Manila, Shenzhen and nuclear talks
bullets: Trump’s Asia trip began in Manila before continuing to Shenzhen.
Economic deals and nuclear talks are central agenda items.
Possible engagement with Kim Jong Un remains uncertain.

articles.title: Trump-Xi-Putin summit raises questions about global order
bullets: The summit is occurring around the APEC meetings in China.
Reuters reporting cited slim chances for a broad backroom deal.
Nuclear and geopolitical issues remain central to discussions.

articles.title: Global stocks slip as markets digest Nvidia and Anthropic news
bullets: Global stocks weakened Wednesday, according to Reuters.
Investors weighed Nvidia’s outlook and Anthropic’s market debut.
Oil also fell after reports of rising US inventories.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Cyclone Akvan expected to intensify over Bay of Bengal
bullets: Cyclone Akvan is moving slowly over the Bay of Bengal.
Forecasters expect further intensification around November 18.
Authorities are monitoring coastal risks and preparedness.

articles.title: Rajnath Singh and Jaishankar in Tokyo for India-Japan 2+2
bullets: India’s defence and foreign ministers are in Tokyo.
The fourth India-Japan 2+2 dialogue is scheduled November 18–19.
Defence cooperation is expected to feature prominently.

articles.title: India space-security doctrine debate gains attention
bullets: A Hindu op-ed urged a comprehensive Indian space-security doctrine.
The article highlighted jamming, spoofing and cyber threats.
Satellite disruption risks now extend beyond physical attacks.

articles.title: India seeks stronger climate engagement with island nations at COP31
bullets: India is emphasizing climate ties with small island nations.
The issue was highlighted in November 18 current-affairs briefings.
Climate vulnerability and cooperation are key discussion themes.

articles.title: India highlights cultural ties with Philippines through gurdwara visit
bullets: India’s MEA cited Khalsa Diwan Gurdwara’s cultural significance.
The story appeared in The Hindu’s November 18 Delhi edition.
Officials framed it as part of India-Philippines people-to-people ties.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top US market movers from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Nvidia rebounds after stronger-than-expected results
bullets: Nvidia shares rose in premarket trading Wednesday.
The company beat Wall Street expectations, AP reported.
The rebound helped lift US stock futures.

articles.title: Lowe’s falls despite lifting outlook
bullets: Lowe’s was listed among Wednesday premarket decliners.
The stock fell even as the company raised its outlook.
Investors reacted cautiously to the earnings update.

articles.title: HPE gains with broader AI-infrastructure rally
bullets: Hewlett Packard Enterprise rose in premarket trading.
The move tracked broader AI-infrastructure strength.
The company also addressed Juniper-router investigation exposure.

articles.title: Major US indexes fell Tuesday as AI doubts weighed
bullets: US indexes declined Tuesday, according to AP.
AI-related stocks led broad market weakness.
Investors awaited key chip and IPO developments.

articles.title: Telus jumps after Quebecor takeover proposal
bullets: Telus rallied after a Quebecor takeover proposal surfaced.
The bid was valued around US$21.7 billion.
The move made Telus a notable large-cap gainer.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Top corporate stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Anthropic presses ahead with blockbuster IPO
bullets: Anthropic is moving forward with its IPO despite market volatility.
AP described timing as difficult for AI listings.
The offering is a major test of AI-investor appetite.

articles.title: Disney targets $3 billion in annual cost savings
bullets: Disney expects $3 billion in annual savings by fiscal 2029.
CEO Josh D’Amaro aims to strengthen streaming competitiveness.
The plan was highlighted in Wednesday’s Wall Street Journal front page.

articles.title: Hancock Whitney to buy Trustmark in $3.2 billion stock deal
bullets: Hancock Whitney agreed to acquire Trustmark.
The transaction is valued at about $3.2 billion in stock.
The deal combines two regional banking franchises.

articles.title: Modine spotlighted as data-center cooling demand grows
bullets: Modine makes cooling systems used by data centers.
Axios highlighted the company amid AI-infrastructure demand.
Data-center thermal management remains a major corporate theme.

articles.title: Oil falls as US inventories rise
bullets: Oil prices fell Wednesday, Reuters reported.
Markets reacted to rising US crude inventories.
The move came alongside softer global equities.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Top technology stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Senator plans AI hearings after watchdog testing
bullets: A Senate leader is preparing hearings on AI safety.
Investigators said major platforms produced terrorist-attack proposals when prompted.
The platforms named were ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok.

articles.title: Nvidia beats expectations after Jensen Huang departure
bullets: Nvidia exceeded Wall Street expectations in its latest report.
The company is navigating Jensen Huang’s abrupt departure.
Its results helped stabilize AI-stock sentiment Wednesday.

articles.title: Waymo suspends California freeway robotaxi operations
bullets: Waymo paused robotaxi rides on US freeways in California.
The development appeared in Wednesday equity-news briefings.
The pause affected Alphabet’s autonomous-driving headlines.

articles.title: Apple restores systems after technology outage
bullets: Apple restored systems after an outage, according to market briefings.
The outage was part of broader technology-snafu concerns.
US officials were also responding to recent infrastructure disruptions.

articles.title: Marvell and Credo settle patent disputes
bullets: Marvell and Credo settled patent disputes, according to Newsquawk.
The settlement was included in Wednesday’s US equity technology roundup.
Both companies are tied to semiconductor and connectivity markets.
